Chapter 154 - 154 Nobel Prize? My Girlfriend Is More Important!

Chapter 154 - 154 Nobel Prize? My Girlfriend Is More Important!

154 Nobel Prize? My Girlfriend Is More Important!

It turned out that this female professor was an economics teacher.

Her voice was crisp and very pleasant. She did not sound like someone in her 40s at all.

The female professor liked to combine facts in her lectures and was full of logic. She was quite attractive.

Lin Fan was barely listening.

However, Lin Fan frowned.

At this moment, the female professor was using an algorithm to explain the changes in the economy.

Lin Fan did not know much about economics.

However, he was definitely an expert in mathematical operations.

He could easily tell that the female professor’s calculation was wrong.

Lin Fan listened to the explanation of the wrong formula. It was like he had eaten something wrong and needed to spit it out.

Finally, Lin Fan could not help but stand up and say, “Teacher, your calculations are wrong.”

As soon as he said this, the entire classroom suddenly fell silent.

Everyone turned to look at Lin Fan.

One had to know that the person standing on the podium was a famous economics professor at Modu University.

In fact, she even had a place in the entire Hua Nation.

Would he use the wrong algorithm?

What kind of joke was this?

The female professor was not angry. She asked, “Which of the formulas do you think is wrong?”

“All of them,” Lin Fan said.

This time, the female professor could no longer remain calm.

After a while, she said in a somewhat funny tone, “Then tell me, how should I calculate it?”

Since he had chosen to stand out and point it out, Lin Fan would not back down.

He walked straight to the podium, picked up a chalk, and quickly wrote the calculations according to the data given by the female professor.

Ed=dQ/dp*p/Q=GB/CG*CG/OG…

Immediately, the entire classroom was filled with a series of rapid knocking sounds, like an intense drum beating. It struck straight at people’s hearts.

In the beginning, the female professor was still relaxed and indifferent.

It was because she was very confident in the calculations she wrote.

However, the female professor did not want to kill the student’s spirit of exploration, so she allowed Lin Fan to write the new formula on the blackboard.

However…

As time passed, the female professor’s calm face gradually revealed a strange expression.

Then, she became serious.

In the end, her face showed excitement.

Lin Fan wrote down a lot of calculations.

After a while, the remaining blank spaces on the blackboard were all used up.

The female professor did not hesitate at all. Like the most hardworking assistant, she quickly wiped all the calculations she had written.

Hence, Lin Fan continued to calculate.

TC=TFC+TVC

FVC=TVC（Q）

….

Gradually, the entire blackboard was almost filled in by Lin Fan.

However, he still had no intention of stopping.

Stop?

No!

Not only did he not stop, but Lin Fan’s writing speed increased.

Moreover, the calculations written were no longer just what the female professor had written on the blackboard.

Instead, he carried out more and more complicated expansion, analysis, and induction…

There might even be a conclusion!

Seeing this…

The female professor’s heart was beating faster.

She said to the students sitting in the first row, “Go to the office and move a few more… No! Bring over ten small blackboards! Hurry up!”

The female professor’s tone was filled with urgency.

She understood that many people relied on inspiration when they calculated.

If he kept this up, then the calculation would most likely succeed.

However, if it was broken.

Then, perhaps… it would be very difficult for him to succeed.

If Lin Fan were to succeed… that would definitely cause a sensation in the entire economics world!

Just thinking about it made the female professor’s heart beat faster.

The students sitting in the first row could not understand what Lin Fan was writing.

However, they could hear the urgency and sternness in the female professor’s tone.

Therefore, they did not dare to hesitate at all and quickly ran toward the office.

After a while, ten small blackboards were brought over.

At this moment, Lin Fan was fully immersed in his calculations.

After taking the small blackboards, he did not stop and continued to write.

[Ding! Absolute Focus, triggered a flash of inspiration!]

Lin Fan’s writing speed was getting faster and faster.

Just as all the calculations were about to be summarized and deduced into a complicated formula…

At this moment, the phone in Lin Fan’s pocket rang.

Lin Fan could not help but put down the chalk in his hand and answer the call.

“Alright, I’ll be right there.”

After Lin Fan hung up, he turned around and walked out of the classroom.

“Where are you going?” The female professor asked anxiously.

Just as he was about to successfully derive the formula, the person deriving it stopped.

It was as if there were many ants crawling on her heart. It was extremely uncomfortable.

“Oh, my girlfriend is waiting for me… I’m going to look for her.” Lin Fan said, “Oh right, I’m not your student.”

The female professor did not care about what Lin Fan said. She hurriedly said, “Student, do you know what you were writing just now?

“If you continue to derive it and verify it correctly, it can become an economics theorem! You might even win the Nobel Prize in Economics!”

When the female professor said this, her voice could not help but become much higher.

Excitement, excitement!

The Nobel Prize was definitely the most coveted honor for all education and scientific researchers.

Now, it was actually possible for it to appear in front of her!

Lin Fan said, “I know, right?”

After saying that, he continued to walk out of the classroom.

Facing the possibility of winning the Nobel Prize…

He… left?

The female professor did not expect such a thing to happen.

She was stunned for a moment.

Then, she hurriedly chased after him and shouted, “Hey, student!”

However…

At this moment, Lin Fan had already walked far away.

Nobel Prize?

For many people, this was indeed very attractive.

It was because this represented honor, fame, and money!

However, Lin Fan was not interested in glory.

As for fame?

That was something he did not want.

Once he became famous, his normal life would be completely affected.

As for money?

Lin Fan did not lack it.

Therefore, this was not attractive to Lin Fan at all.

Relatively speaking, it was more important to meet Qin Yuxuan as soon as possible.

At this moment, Qin Yuxuan was waiting at the school gate.

Qin Yuxuan was wearing a white lace dress today. She had a perfect figure and snow-white skin… Under the rays of the setting sun, her entire body was dazzling, like a fairy who had descended to the mortal world. She was extremely beautiful.

Anyone who passed by, regardless of gender…could not help but look sideways.

Women were jealous.

Men, on the other hand, yearned for her.

When Lin Fan walked over from afar, Qin Yuxuan’s pretty face was as radiant as a spring breeze.

Then, Qin Yuxuan threw herself into Lin Fan’s embrace.

This pounce was like a heavy hammer, hitting the chests of the boys passing by.

The sound of their hearts shattering echoed in their minds.
